Author: roshiu0483
Description:
Anime-style portraits for Sunberry Village (with my own taste)
only Amina now, plan to finish the remaining 18 characters by August (maybe)

没琢磨明白代码所以使用了古老的文件替换大法，命名带original的是备份的原肖像。

how to use:
1.Download this file.
2.Back up the original portrait( already included in my file ) and overwrite the Sunberry Village MOD file.

Or you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url], The linked page provides instructions on how to use it. Download Portraiture(999),Unzip the files into Stardew Valley\ Mods, then create a new folder under \Portraiture\Portraits\ and put all my PNGs in it. Press P to change Portrait-Set in games' DialogBox whenever you want.
